comment: Descriptor fragments loaded on their own terms, with no document in hand. loaded or schema_error. Each refused fragment carries exactly one defect, and must_name lists words the refusal must contain. These are the load-time rules of schema-descriptor/v1 plus the v2 extensions; a consumer that validates a document against an unloaded schema has not validated it.

cases.name: bounded_integer_loads
cases.note: A well-formed descriptor.

cases.name: unrecognised_property_refused
cases.note: Neither the core nor v2 defines minLength; a validator would silently not enforce it.

cases.name: nan_bound_refused
cases.note: Every comparison against NaN is false, so the bound admits everything.

cases.name: infinite_bound_refused
cases.note: Infinity is not a finite bound.

cases.name: boolean_bound_refused
cases.note: true is not a number.

cases.name: fractional_bound_on_integer_refused
cases.note: 1.5 is a boundary no integer sits on.

cases.name: minimum_above_maximum_refused
cases.note: A descriptor admitting nothing.

cases.name: exclusive_minimum_with_minimum_refused
cases.note: The two lower bounds are mutually exclusive.

cases.name: exclusive_minimum_at_maximum_refused
cases.note: Nothing lies strictly above the maximum.

cases.name: bound_on_string_refused
cases.note: Bounds are numeric.

cases.name: empty_enum_refused
cases.note: A vocabulary with no members.

cases.name: enum_member_of_wrong_type_refused
cases.note: An integer in a string vocabulary.

cases.name: enum_member_outside_bounds_refused
cases.note: A member the descriptor's own bounds reject.

cases.name: object_without_properties_refused
cases.note: An open object one level down.

cases.name: object_with_properties_and_entries_refused
cases.note: Exactly one of the two.

cases.name: array_without_items_refused
cases.note: Unvalidated elements.

cases.name: items_on_non_array_refused
cases.note: items only describes an array.

cases.name: default_rejected_by_own_descriptor_refused
cases.note: A default the descriptor refuses appears only for whoever omits the key.

cases.name: required_with_default_refused
cases.note: Mutually exclusive.

cases.name: required_not_boolean_refused
cases.note: required is a boolean.

cases.name: unknown_type_refused
cases.note: float is not a descriptor type.

cases.name: pattern_on_non_string_refused
cases.note: A pattern only constrains a string.

cases.name: pattern_that_does_not_compile_refused
cases.note: Refused at load, not at the first document that exercises it.

cases.name: default_not_matching_pattern_refused
cases.note: The default is checked against the pattern like any other value.

cases.name: delegate_unknown_contract_refused
cases.note: Delegation names a contract this version lists.

cases.name: delegate_without_properties_refused
cases.note: Delegation extends declared properties; it does not replace them.

cases.name: nested_defect_named_by_path_refused
cases.note: A defect two levels down is named by its path.
